14517.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Beautiful Christmas decoration
- Striking reindeer design
- Turns your home into a winter wonderland

## Information
Turn your home and garden into a true winter wonderland with this impressive and majestic LED Festive Reindeer Decoration. This festive light decoration has been elegantly crafted into a reindeer shape, giving it the impression of movement for a striking look, and has been studded with over 1000 LED lights that glow bright white in the dark. Perfect for standing in your back garden or out by your doorstep, this reindeer would look perfect on its down and also works well with other standing decorations to create a Christmas-themed scene. The ideal decorative accessory for any home over the winter, the reindeer comes with a 5m lead wire so you can plug it in almost anywhere with convenience.
